record.original_question: Let positive real parameters a1, ..., ad, b and positive integers m1, ..., md be such that the hypergeometric generating function satisfies _{d+1}F_d(a1+m1, ..., ad+md, b ; a1, ..., ad ; x) = A(x) / (1 - x)^(m+b), where m = sum_j m_j and A(x) is a polynomial. Find sufficient conditions on a1, ..., ad, b, m1, ..., md that guarantee that A(x) has only real zeros, equivalently only negative zeros.

evidence.quote: Suppose a1, a2, ..., ad, b > 0 are real and m1, m2, ..., md > 0 are integer. Define the polynomial A(x) by _{d+1}F_d(a1 + m1, a2 + m2, ..., ad + md, b ; a1, a2, ..., ad ; x) = A(x) / (1 - x)^(m+b).
Open problem. Find sufficient conditions on a1, a2, ..., ad, b, m1, m2, ..., md ensuring that A(x) has only real zeros (only negative zeros).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $d\ge 1$ be an integer. Let $a_1,\ldots,a_d,b$ be positive real numbers, and let $m_1,\ldots,m_d$ be positive integers. Set $m=\sum_{j=1}^d m_j$. Consider the generalized hypergeometric function
$$
{}_{d+1}F_d\!\left(\begin{array}{c} a_1+m_1,\,a_2+m_2,\,\ldots,\,a_d+m_d,\,b \\ a_1,\,a_2,\,\ldots,\,a_d \end{array};\,x\right)=\sum_{n\ge 0}\frac{(a_1+m_1)_n\cdots(a_d+m_d)_n (b)_n}{(a_1)_n\cdots(a_d)_n}\,\frac{x^n}{n!},
$$
where $(c)_n=c(c+1)\cdots(c+n-1)$ is the Pochhammer symbol. Because each ratio $(a_j+m_j)_n/(a_j)_n$ is a polynomial in $n$ of degree $m_j$, there exists a polynomial $A(x)$ (of degree $m$) such that
$$
{}_{d+1}F_d\!\left(\begin{array}{c} a_1+m_1,\,\ldots,\,a_d+m_d,\,b \\ a_1,\,\ldots,\,a_d \end{array};\,x\right)=\frac{A(x)}{(1-x)^{m+b}}.
$$
Determine sufficient conditions on the parameters $a_1,\ldots,a_d,\,b,\,m_1,\ldots,m_d$ that ensure that all zeros of $A(x)$ are real (equivalently, since $A$ has nonnegative coefficients up to standard normalization, that all zeros of $A(x)$ are negative real numbers).
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as an open problem in a 2023 compilation of open problems on polynomials and their zero distributions. A related recent work (arXiv:2309.10970) studies real-rootedness of certain hypergeometric polynomials via finite free convolution, providing partial results, but no general sufficient condition resolving the problem in full has been identified.

status_evidence.title: Open problems on polynomials, their zero distribution and related questions: 2023
status_evidence.snippet: Collection of open problems presented at the Hausdorff Geometry of Polynomials workshop, 2023.
status_evidence.claim: The real-rootedness question for the hypergeometric numerator polynomial A(x) is listed as an open problem.

status_evidence.title: Real roots of hypergeometric polynomials via finite free convolution
status_evidence.snippet: Studies real-rootedness of hypergeometric polynomials using finite free convolution techniques.
status_evidence.claim: Partial results toward real-rootedness of related hypergeometric polynomials are known, but a general sufficient criterion remains open.
